svg.text: Speed and efficiency against power cap
Efficiency peaks below stock cap on every card. ≥ marks a bound: still rising at the lowest cap swept.
Different machines, operating systems and instruments: cross-card gaps are not comparable.
x: power cap set, not power drawn. sol/s: CPU-verified solutions.
